questions.question: Explain the three patterns by which a cash receipt affects the accounting equation, giving two examples of each.
questions.expected_answer: Every cash receipt increases the asset bank (bank is debited). Pattern 1: A increases and OE increases — capital contributed; income earned (current income, rent income, interest income). Pattern 2: A increases and L increases — loan received from a bank or lender. Pattern 3: A increases and another asset decreases (no change in total assets) — sale of an asset at book value; receipt from a debtor.

questions.question: Show the effect on A, OE and L (with reasons for OE) of: capital R40 000; current income R3 500; loan R30 000; rent income R1 200; sale of a camera at its book value of R2 400; a debtor pays R1 500.
questions.expected_answer: Capital: A +40 000; OE +40 000 (capital contribution); L 0. Current income: A +3 500; OE +3 500 (income); L 0. Loan: A +30 000; OE 0; L +30 000. Rent income: A +1 200; OE +1 200 (income); L 0. Camera: A +2 400 (bank) and −2 400 (equipment); OE 0; L 0. Debtor: A +1 500 (bank) and −1 500 (debtors); OE 0; L 0.

questions.question: A studio's receipts in a month are: capital R40 000, current income R3 500, loan R30 000, rent income R1 200, interest income R85, additional capital R5 000, camera sold at book value R2 400 and debtor paid R1 500. Calculate the total bank receipts, the net increase in assets, OE and L, and prove the equation balances.
questions.expected_answer: Bank receipts = 40 000 + 3 500 + 30 000 + 1 200 + 85 + 5 000 + 2 400 + 1 500 = R83 685. Assets decreased by 2 400 + 1 500 = R3 900, so net increase in assets = R79 785. OE = 40 000 + 3 500 + 1 200 + 85 + 5 000 = R49 785. L = R30 000. 49 785 + 30 000 = 79 785 = net increase in assets, so the equation balances.
